From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@cloudmesh.io>

Cc: procure@cloudmesh.io
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO window & spend cap

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking our onboarding. We're ready to get set up in your procurement system. Can you advise what the temporary PO process looks like while our corporate procurement team completes the SOW and legal review? We expect initial spend ~ $18k over first 30 days (pilot); can we get a provisional PO or spend window to begin billing?

Attached are our onboarding form and SOC2 summary; we'll share the full contract after legal review. Also attaching our invoice template so you can confirm remit fields.

Ask:
- Provisional PO number for pilot
- Any required vendor setup fields we should include on your onboarding form
- Spend cap or temporary limit process

Thanks,

--
Aisha Khan
Head of Procurement
CloudMesh Inc.

Hi Aisha — welcome, and thanks for the docs.

Short answer: we can provision a temporary PO and a staged spend cap to let you start the pilot. Need a couple of things before we issue:
- Completed Redwood vendor setup form (I've attached our minimal vendor details template below)
- Billing contact and remit-to email (if different from finance@cloudmesh.io)
- Confirmation of the initial pilot SKU(s) and estimated token/usage bands (helps with line-item splits)

I'll loop in procurement ops to provision a provisional PO once we have the vendor form and the remit details. Expect a provisional PO number within one business day after we receive the form.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
